Lectures: 2 Duration 1.5 Hrs. /Lecture Prerequisite None Follow Up Advanced UI/UX Design, Software Engineering Category Domain Elective Aims and Objectives This course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive introduction to the field of Human Computer Interaction

ts with a comprehensive introduction to the field of Human Computer Interaction (HCI). The course aims to impart foundational knowledge required to design useful and usable interactive systems based on users’ needs and contextual requirements. It focuses on understanding human capabilities, interaction models, design principles, usability evaluation techniques, and the development of prototypes to enhance user experience.
